params.body:
Step 1 of the new look: typography only. No colours, corners or layouts change here.

## What changes

- **Inter, from our own build.** `resources/fonts/inter-latin.woff2` and `inter-latin-ext.woff2` (the variable font, weights in one file per subset, SIL Open Font License, licence in `resources/fonts/OFL.txt`) go through Vite and get a hashed name in `public/build`. Two `@font-face` rules with `unicode-range` and `font-display: swap`, so latin-ext (the S with caron in Škoda, IJ) is fetched only by a page that has such a character. A metric-adjusted Arial (`Inter Fallback`) shows while the font loads, so the swap moves nothing.
- **One file for type**: `resources/css/type.css` holds the faces, the tokens (`--ui-font`, `--ui-size-base` 15px, `--ui-leading-base`, `--ui-w-text` 400, `--ui-w-strong` 500, `--ui-w-title` 600) and the base of the text. `tailwind.css` imports it, so every layout of the app has it; it is also a build entry of its own, and `<x-ui.type />` gives it to the pages that carry their own styles. Tailwind's `font-sans` is the same stack and its `fontWeight` scale now offers only `normal`, `medium` and `semibold`.
- **Base 15px / 400 / 1.5** (was 14px / 300 / 1.5).
- **Three weights.** Every 300 and `lighter` became 400; every 700, 800, 900, `bold` and `bolder` on text became 600 (theme, `refresh.css`, the legacy layer, `insights.css`, inline styles). `b`, `strong`, `th` and `dt`, which a browser sets at 700 by itself, are 600. No 600 was trimmed to 500: that is a later step. Icon fonts keep their own weight (Font Awesome solid is 900).
- **Tabular figures** on the page (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` on `body` and the form controls). Poppins had no figures of one width at all; prices, dates and mileages now stand under each other in the lists, the cards and the fields.

## What loaded Poppins before

| Where | How |
|---|---|
| `resources/css/theme.src.min.css` (the bought theme, every app page) | `@import` from fonts.googleapis.com, weights 300 to 700; `font-family: Poppins` on `body`, headings, tooltip, popover and `--font-family-sans-serif`; `body` at 14px / 300 |
| `resources/css/legacy/vehicle/error_box.css` (in `legacy/app.css`, every app page) | a second `@import` of the same Google stylesheet |
| `public/template/css/pages/login-register-lock.css` (the Passport consent page) | a third `@import` |
| `settings/release_notes/form.blade.php` | the TinyMCE editor imported Poppins from Google inside its frame; it now takes `type.css` from the build as `content_css` |

Pages that were on a system font or on the old 230-glyph file in `public/fonts` and are now on the same Inter from the build: the error pages (`errors/layout`, `503`), the stopped-account page, the public proposal page, `/docs` and the embed preview, the Passport consent page, the environment bar. A missing build manifest prints no link in `<x-ui.type />`, so an error page still renders and falls back to the system font.

## Walked at 1440 and 390

Stocklist list and detail, own stock list, vehicle form, bidding offers, bid detail, own bidding list, bids received, transports, the transport window, worklists, insights, settings, location form, users (Beheer), offers, orders, relations, the public proposal page, a 404, login and password reset: 23 screens, both widths.

Measured on every screen before and after: the weight and the family of every visible character, document width against viewport, every element that truncates, every button or badge whose label wraps.

- Before: 300 was the most used weight on every app screen (stocklist 961 of 2206 characters, insights 6723 of 8761), with 700 and 800 next to it. After: only 400, 500 and 600, and every character in Inter.
- No screen gained a horizontal scrollbar, a truncation or a wrapping button: the counts per screen are the same before and after. Inter is narrower than Poppins by about 5% and the base grew by 1px, which roughly cancel, so no fixed width needed tuning.
- Fixed on the way: `h1` on the error and stopped-account pages rendered at the browser's 700; the price on the proposal page was 700; the 404 code was 800; the insights page title was 700; `.warranty-tip strong` and the old error box were 900.
- The wordmark in the top bar (`x-ui.logo`) was already set in Inter 600 by its own inline style; it is pixel for pixel what it was, and now reads `--ui-font`.

## Not in this pull request (follow-up)

- **PDFs** (affiche, order forms, offers, rentals, agreement and borderel prints): TCPDF with `helvetica` and `dejavusans`, and `font-weight: bold` in the print views. Untouched.
- **Showroom slides** drawn in PHP use `public/fonts/Inter-Medium.ttf` and `Inter-SemiBold.ttf`: already Inter, untouched.
- **E-mails**: a system stack (`-apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial`) with weights 500, 600 and `bold`. Untouched; a webfont in mail is its own decision.
- **The dealer's website** (`website/theme`, `public/css/website-*.css`, the iframe): Inter from `public/fonts/InterVariable.woff2` (latin only) unless the dealer picked a Google font, with weights up to 800. That is the dealer's look, not the platform's; adding latin-ext there is a small follow-up.
- **The dealer's Google font** on his proposal page and the font picker on the settings page still talk to Google Fonts, by the dealer's choice (R S2-5.19). The existing finding `2026-09-15-fontkiezer-zonder-websitetab` covers the picker loading on every settings tab.
- Trimming 600 to 500 per component, the cool greys, the three radii: the next steps.

## Rule and tests

- New rule **R P1-1.25** (one typeface, served by the platform, three weights, 15px, tabular figures).
- `TypographyTest` (`@rule P1-1.25`): nothing on screen names Poppins; no screen asks a font host for a typeface (the dealer's own choice is the named exception); no weight below 400 or above 600 in any screen stylesheet, view or inline style, with icon fonts excepted; the tokens live in one place and Tailwind's stack equals `--ui-font`; both font files are in the build manifest, on disk, and what the built stylesheet points at.
- `refresh.css` did not grow: 6071 lines and 472 `!important`, as budgeted; the changes there are values on existing lines.
- Full suite: 2735 tests green locally. PHPStan: no errors. ESLint: no errors. Vitest: 16 passed.
params.title: One typeface from our own build: Inter in three weights
